_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/triggers/test_face_down_filter.py. t_fdf_pipes is They Came from the Pipes' 'Whenever a face-down creature you control enters', reduced to a draw; t_fdf_faceup_watch is its negation, gaining life. t_fdf_landfall is a bare landfall trigger, so a test can show a manifested land enters as the 2/2 shell and not as a land. t_fdf_glitch is Glitch Interpreter's intervening-if 'if you control no face-down permanents', reduced to a draw. t_fdf_whisper is Whisperwood Elemental's 'face-up nontoken creatures you control' as a one-shot pump. t_fdf_etb_morph is a morph creature with an enters trigger of its own, which a face-down arrival must not fire.
